items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, and who else? Three of them. And Joe Ruzon. [INTERVIEWEE] Uh-huh. Joe Phillips. Uh-huh. Joe Phillips and Leo.

ctx.x: He said, now, didn't I tell you that? No, you can't play nothing. What happened, Gay? You can't play nothing. No, you see? The music automatically stopped.
Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, Elliot Taylor, Arthur Durbny, and who else? Three of them. And Joe Ruzon.
Uh-huh. Joe Phillips. Uh-huh. Joe Phillips and Leo.
